title: Calculate Marketplace Settlement
description: Use basis points to calculate fee and seller proceeds in stropes.

content.prompt: For a 100 XLM sale with a 250 bps marketplace fee, how many XLM go to the seller?

hint: 250 basis points is 2.5 percent: 100 * 0.025 = 2.5, so seller proceeds are 97.5 XLM.
